The '''Battle of Allanteen''' was an early battle of the [[Jedi Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. Following the [[Battle of Foerost (Jedi Civil War)|sacking]] of [[Foerost/Legends|Foerost]], new battlefronts opened up across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] because of the advancing Sith Empire. The Sith [[Battle of Roche (Jedi Civil War)|advanced]] on [[Roche asteroid field|Roche]] and [[Battle of Axxila|Axxila]] then invaded and conquered the [[Allanteen system/Legends|Allanteen system]], including [[Allanteen VI/Legends|Allanteen Six]]. At the highest extent of the Sith Empire, Allanteen remained under Imperial control as part of an isolated area of Sith space. It was used as a launching point for the Sith [[Battle of Rhommamool|attack]] on [[Rhommamool/Legends|Rhommamool]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Allanteen makes its only appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EA" /> An exact date is not provided for the battle. The Battle of Foerost and the [[Bombing of Telos IV]], however, are placed in [[3958 BBY]] by the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'',<ref name="KotORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and the ''Atlas'' lists Allanteen as having followed Foerost and subsequent attacks, but preceding Telos.<ref name="EA" />
